topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: The integration of L-DACS into congested airspaces introduces complex spectrum sharing challenges between A2G and satellite links. Advanced array factor optimization and interference mitigation techniques, such as adaptive beamforming and AI-driven feedback loops, can significantly reduce interference. The high velocity of aircraft in the A2A phase leads to severe frequency selective fading and Rician distributed fading, exacerbating interference issues. Managing this overlap requires precise array factor optimization and interference mitigation techniques to ensure both A2G and satellite links operate efficiently without degradation in performance or capacity.
